campos.descripcion: Raspberry Pi 5 is the latest generation of Raspberry Pi’s hugely popular single-board computer, with a faster 2.4GHz quad-core processor. It’s available with 1GB, 2GB, 4GB, 8GB or 16GB RAM, so there’s a Pi 5 for everything from small embedded projects to desktop computing and more demanding builds.

Raspberry Pi 5 with 1GB, 2GB, 4GB, 8GB or 16GB RAM. A powerful single-board computer with a 2.4GHz quad-core CPU, dual 4K display support and PCIe.
